plan.subject: Understand the core principles and implementation of linear regression, including its mathematical formulation, cost function, optimization techniques, and applications.
plan.objective: Understand the core principles and implementation of linear regression, including its mathematical formulation, cost function, optimization techniques, and applications.

blocks.title: What is Linear Regression?
blocks.teachingObjective: Linear regression is the foundation for modeling continuous outcomes using a linear relationship between variables.

blocks.title: Cost Function and Mean Squared Error (MSE)
blocks.teachingObjective: The cost function quantifies the error between predicted and actual values, guiding the optimization process.
examples: MSE is a differentiable and convex function
Residual plots expose a biased model

blocks.title: Gradient Descent Optimization
blocks.teachingObjective: Gradient descent is an iterative method to minimize the cost function by adjusting model parameters.
examples: Gradient descent approach: How it works

blocks.title: Linear Regression Model Formulation
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the mathematical form of the model is essential for interpreting and implementing linear regression.
examples: Write down f_w(x) for house pricing
Linear regression model: f_w(x) = w_0 + w_1x

blocks.title: Closed-Form Solution and Matrix Operations
blocks.teachingObjective: The closed-form solution provides an alternative to gradient descent for solving linear regression problems using linear algebra.
examples: Closed-form approach: Does it always work?
